groups.note: E47 の「Judaism（ユダヤ教）」は英語だけ（韓国語はイスラム教とキリスト教）
diff: The Korean original names only Islam and Christianity (English edition adds “Judaism”).

en.ko: 이슬람교도의 씨를 말리기 위한 인종청소가 자행되어

groups.note: 食い違い: 韓国語は「7千余人のイスラム教徒」、英語は「thousands」とぼかし、イスラム教徒であることも言わない
diff: The Korean original says ethnic cleansing was carried out to wipe out the Muslims, and that more than seven thousand Muslims, including children, were massacred (English edition: “thousands, including many children”).

groups.note: E64 の「2001年」「何千もの命が失われた」は英語だけ。E65 は「イスラエル南部」も足し、イスラエルのミサイル攻撃とは言わない。E66「家が壊され」は英語だけ
diff: The Korean original says the planes split the 110-story World Trade Center buildings in two, and gives neither the year nor a death toll (English edition: “September 11, 2001,” “thousands of innocent lives were lost,” “completely destroyed”).

The Korean original says hundreds have died in the Gaza Strip from missile attacks carried out by Israel, and that people are trembling in cold, hunger, and fear of death (English edition: “in the Gaza Strip in Palestine as well as in southern Israel,” “as a result of that intense conflict,” “Homes have been destroyed”).
